Class Slime

java.lang.Object
model.common.Entity
model.enemy.BaseEnemy
model.enemy.Slime
All Implemented Interfaces:
Collidable, Damageable, Renderable, Updatable
public class Slime extends BaseEnemy
Small, fast melee enemy that chases the player directly. Low HP but high speed makes it a swarming threat in groups.
